products.name: NUU B40 5G Unlocked Android Phone with 1.6-inch Rear AMOLED Screen, 8 GB / 256 GB
specs: 64 MP main + 2 MP macro on the back, 16 MP front
T-Mobile and T-Mobile-based carriers (Metro, Mint and others)
products.warranty: 1 year from purchase. NUU repairs or replaces defects. You pay shipping to the repair center. Water and accidental damage are not covered.
products.returns: 30 days from the invoice date when bought from NUU's store. The phone must be as new, with all accessories and the box, and you need an RMA by email. The return policy page says the buyer pays return shipping, but the product page advertises free returns.
products.summary: A budget 5G phone with a small AMOLED screen on the back. It shows the time, notifications and music controls, and works as a viewfinder so you can take selfies with the main camera.
products.fit: Best for people on T-Mobile, Mint or Metro who want a rear screen for main-camera selfies and quick glances without spending flip-phone money.
caveats: Works only on T-Mobile's network and carriers that use it. Not for Verizon or AT&T.
No NFC, so no tap-to-pay with Google Wallet.
NUU publishes no OS or security update schedule. One reviewer's phone got no update in its first two months.
No headphone jack, no published water-resistance rating, and the 2 MP macro camera adds little.
